claims.description: Deterministic coaching responses come from the already-wired test-only provider boundary: the e2e CI workflow boots the dedicated test worker entrypoint, unreachable in production (which boots src/index.ts).
The deterministic LLM provider implementation behind that boundary.
Runner applies each flow's declared uiMode via adb cmd uimode immediately before app launch; undeclared flows leave the mode untouched.
Plan generator threads the uiMode frontmatter field through the TSV/JSON plan as a backwards-compatible third column.
Light flow waits on the real assistant-response-complete testID and asserts the exact deterministic fixture reply copy.
Dark flow, same oracle and copy assertion, uiMode dark declared in frontmatter.

DELIVERED: blocked tags and PARKED headers removed — both flows enter the nightly suite (smoke tag) and PASSED on a real Android release-variant APK in e2e-ci evidence run 30219395887 (dispatched on the rework branch; every shard succeeded; shard log shows coach-bubble-dark as flow four of twenty-two with uiMode dark applied and coach-bubble-light as flow five with uiMode light applied). Copy assertions widened to accept the typographer-rendered apostrophe after diagnostic run 30217730898 exposed the mismatch. Pointer shows the un-quarantined tag block at the pinned revision.
The parked-flows corpus canary recalibrated to the post-un-parking corpus size, with the recalibration rationale in an adjacent comment; the per-flow machine-exclusion guard is untouched.
